name: swell
title: Swell
description: Eighteen columns of hairline dashes in equal-gap stacks. Under the pointer the dashes thicken into a diamond-shaped bump that squeezes its neighbours; the grid flattens when it leaves.
docs: One self-contained file, react only: no Tailwind, no other dependency. Mount <Swell /> inside an element with position: relative and a size; it covers that element and is decoration only: give it no link or click handler. Suggested commit: feat: add Swell hover texture (textures.dev/s/swell)
